prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 常用化学试剂清单 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "名称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 123px
  col 2: header "分子式" · longest unbreakable word 135px · one-line width 135px
  col 3: header "CAS 号" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 78px
  col 4: header "纯度" · longest unbreakable word 54px · one-line width 135px
  col 5: header "储存条件（长）" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 1145px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"列出常用化学试剂及其身份、纯度和储存条件，供查找和安全储存时参考。","reading":"读者通常先按名称定位试剂，再核对分子式和 CAS 号，并沿同一行查看纯度及储存要求；横向滚动时，保持各行对应关系很重要。","groups":["名称、分子式和 CAS 号共同识别试剂；其中分子式和 CAS 号适合逐项核对。","纯度和储存条件描述试剂规格与使用要求，储存条件通常需要最多的文字空间。"],"keep_intact":["分子式和 CAS 号应尽量保持完整，避免拆分后难以核对。","纯度数值及其单位或符号应尽量保持完整。","试剂名称应尽量保持易于辨认。"],"may_wrap":["较长的储存条件可按自然语义换行，形成的行高也可容纳其他列的换行。","较长的试剂名称和纯度描述可适度换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [144, 156, 99, 156, 240] · table 796×1082px · row heights [36, 153, 153, 153, 153, 129, 153, 153] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 436px
Design r0B: widths [110, 156, 99, 80, 174] · table 620×1407px · row heights [36, 199, 199, 199, 199, 176, 199, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 260px
Design r0C: widths [68, 72, 66, 68, 85] · table 360×3197px · row heights [60, 455, 455, 455, 478, 385, 455, 455] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 20 lines · mid-word splits 8

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"名称、分子式和 CAS 号均保持完整；较宽的储存条件列减少了换行，行高是三个方案中最低的。","problems":"初始视口只容纳名称、分子式及部分 CAS 号，读者必须横向滚动才能核对完整标识或查看纯度和储存条件。各行在前几列留下大量空白，滚动后也需要仔细保持行对应。","cause":"名称列 144px 足以容纳最长名称，但与 156px 的分子式列、99px 的 CAS 号列合计 399px；纯度列 156px 和储存条件列 240px 又将总宽推至 796px。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"初始视口基本呈现名称、完整分子式和 CAS 号，便于定位与核对；总宽比 r0A 小，且没有词中拆分。","problems":"最长名称换成两行；储存条件使每行更高，身份列因此出现大片空白。纯度和储存条件仍需横向滚动，较长的行也增加了跨列对照的负担。","cause":"名称列 110px 小于最长名称的单行需求；储存条件列由 240px 缩至 174px，使长文本增至最多 8 行。前三列合计 365px，略超 359px 的目标宽度。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"整张表都在视口内，可以同时看到各字段，且无需横向滚动。","problems":"化学式、CAS 号和纯度数值被拆开，难以可靠核对；储存条件被挤成很窄的文字条，行高过大，表头也发生换行，扫描和比较都很吃力。","cause":"分子式列仅 72px，远小于最长不可拆分内容所需的 156px；CAS 号列 66px、纯度列 68px 也不足以容纳部分完整内容。储存条件列仅 85px，使长文本达到最多 20 行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"identity-first","widths":[104,156,99,90,240],"change":"将前三列合计控制在 359px，首屏完整呈现身份信息；接受最长名称换行，保留完整分子式和 CAS 号。压缩纯度列，并恢复较宽的储存条件列，以降低行高。"},{"name":"compact-scroll","widths":[104,156,99,80,200],"change":"保留首屏身份信息，在滚动距离和储存条件的换行之间取中间值；相比 r0B 增加储存条件宽度，同时缩短名称列以使前三列进入视口。"},{"name":"wider-storage","widths":[104,156,99,90,300],"change":"保留首屏身份信息，进一步加宽储存条件列，检验减少长段落换行和行高是否值得额外横向滚动。"}]}
